description: The evidence that lowers a finding's reachability class, one row per kind of evidence: the class it lowers the finding to, the languages and the codes it applies to, and the rule of grammar/analysis/confidence.md, or of another page of the analysis, that states when it holds. A finding takes the lowest class the rows that hold for it give; a row never raises a class. A kind's max_class and the component cap of grammar/analysis/confidence.md apply after these rows.

evidence.description: A subject of a library's published API, while a declared consumer did not load.
A subject of a library's published API, in a run that holds no consumer information.
A declaration outside an internal tree of a Go package of an application that no build links, in a run that declares no consumer.
A package-level Go declaration whose identifier a string literal of a production file spells.
A TypeScript member whose name the left operand of an in expression of a production file spells.
A field the encoding-reflection class records only as filled by a callee outside the analyzed program.
A member of a type the program only decodes into, where a callee outside the analysis, or an any or unknown value, fills it.
A declaration of a TypeScript file only tests reach that is no test-support file, and each dead declaration it reaches through dead declarations.
A declaration of a Go package only tests reach that is no test-support package and that test code references, and each dead declaration it reaches or holds.
A member that only records of exemption classes whose confidence is possible hold.
A TypeScript declaration found dead under reachability alone, or a file only dead code imports, while ts.roots_complete is not true.
A finding the roots cap applies to, in a configuration that compiles a load by a computed path.
